details: Lock-deadline-guard is a mutex wrapper whose sole dependency, mutex-forge, contains an obfuscated implant (lib/withLoad.min.js). On load it fingerprints the host (hostname, platform, CPU count, total memory, uptime, architecture) and exfiltrates the data to Telegram via api[.]telegram[.]org/bot<token>/sendMessage and to Slack via slack[.]com/api/chat.postMessage using a hardcoded xoxb- bot token. It also embeds hardcoded Alchemy and Infura Ethereum RPC endpoints, AES-GCM/PBKDF2/x25519 cryptography, and wallet/private-key handling, and can terminate processes (taskkill/kill). Installing the package pulls in and executes this malicious dependency.
